classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: tiles are read by the separate _prefetch multiprocessing.Process feeding a bounded queue while the main loop computes (probe.sleep_seconds(compute_s)) and consumes masks, so the read is overlapped rather than waited on, is local to the rank's own prefetch worker, and each tile file is read once per measure pass with repeats = 3.

classes.name: masks
classes.reason: the main loop calls probe.read_staged on the mask path inline and times it as gated stall before any compute can proceed, with no collective barrier holding other ranks, and each mask file is read once per pass over cell.items with repeats = 3.
